title: A股开盘反弹确认政策托底，港交所业绩获正反馈，华新并购遭市场否定
summary: 约09:45，上证、深证与创业板分别涨0.73%、1.16%和1.64%，政策托底与隔夜科技修复获得A股开盘确认；香港交易所涨0.83%并站上388港元，升级为看多候选；华新建材跌4.81%否定并购催化，转为回避；汇聚科技反弹2.71%仍不足以覆盖前日13.01%下跌。

关键词云图

A股开盘修复 强非农 港交所确认 华新负反馈 政策托底 回购待执行
重大新闻汇总
国际
美国10月非农大幅超预期，12月加息预期升温
新增非农就业16.5万人，远高于Reuters调查的6.5万人；失业率降至4.1%。10年期美债收益率升至约4.86%，市场计入的12月加息概率升至约78%，高估值成长股仍受压。来源：Reuters。
国际
伊朗局势缓和预期令油价周一开盘回落
Trump称若谈判取得强有力协议，新一轮攻击可能不再必要；Reuters最新更新显示Brent约跌0.64%至97.67美元。海峡航运事件仍使地缘溢价难以完全消退。来源：Reuters。
政策
国常会要求完善资本市场稳市机制
11月6日国务院常务会议要求增强股市内在稳定性，并加快重大项目和“六张网”建设，支持设备更新和无形资产投资。政策方向有利于风险偏好，但不等于个股即时买点。来源：国务院常务会议。
政策
国家发展改革委推进“六网协同”项目与场景
国家发展改革委要求抓紧配套政策、项目库、信息共享和要素保障，支持“六网协同”新场景。算力、通信、能源和物流基础设施是潜在映射，订单仍需公司公告确认。来源：国家发展改革委。
科技
工信部拟建立统一机器人产品“身份证”
《机器人产品标识码管理暂行办法》公开征求意见，拟用统一标识码规范生产制造并支撑安全治理。当前仍是征求意见稿，不把政策方向等同于企业收入。来源：工业和信息化部。
科技
北京经开区加码开源开放信创与前沿场景
政策聚焦人工智能、6G、量子信息、超节点服务器和AI终端等首试首用，部分场景支持最高3000万元；属于区域产业政策，受益对象仍需逐一核验。来源：北京市政府。
材料
商务部对欧盟对位芳纶长丝发起反倾销调查
调查自11月6日起启动，覆盖芳纶1414长丝。国内材料企业可能受关注，但立案不等于最终征税，需求、价格与产能利用率仍需验证。来源：商务部。
公告
杰创智能签署49.15亿元算力技术服务合同
合同暂定总额49.15亿元、期限60个月，按月结算并分批交付。大额合同强化AI云服务线索，但客户履约、资本投入、交付节奏和利润率仍是核心风险。来源：财联社周末公告汇总。
公告
国际复材拟投11.58亿元建设高性能电子纤维布项目
项目规划年产1.11亿米电子级玻璃纤维布，建设期约11个月。方向对应电子材料国产化，但产能投放、爬坡和下游需求决定兑现速度。来源：财联社周末公告汇总。
港股
香港交易所首三季收入与利润双位数增长
首三季收入及其他收益同比增12%至246亿港元，股东应占溢利增15%至154亿港元。11月9日09:45股价388.80港元、涨0.83%，重新站上首轮设定的388港元确认位，业绩催化获得价格确认；仍需警惕成交与IPO周期波动。来源：香港交易所、东方财富延时报价。
公告
华新建材拟约16.42亿美元收购巴西水泥资产
公司拟收购CSN Cimentos 99.99%股权，交易仍需中巴审批。11月9日09:45股价26.14元、跌4.81%，显著跌破27.46元前收，市场负反馈否定周末并购催化，转为回避。来源：巨潮资讯、东方财富延时报价。
港股
汇聚科技拟24个月内回购不超过5亿港元股份
11月9日09:45股价10.23港元、涨2.71%，但仍未收复11月6日13.01%的跌幅，也未站回10.66港元重新评估位；回购尚为授权意向，维持回避。来源：公司公告索引、东方财富延时报价。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
科技修复获确认，但道指与利率仍显示分化
11月6日收盘，QQQ 656.10美元、+1.40%，SPY 735.29美元、+0.35%，DIA 512.22美元、-0.39%；SOX反弹4.2%。强非农同时推高收益率，因此属于科技超跌修复而非全面风险偏好回归。
板块对照
广告、电力与激光雷达领涨，博彩行业仍最弱
Moomoo快照显示广告代理+6.73%、独立电力生产商+6.68%；概念端激光雷达+14.57%、加密矿企+12.67%。博彩行业-6.43%。运行时公开行情与EVC、OKLO、INDI、IREN等同向，稀土代表UURAF未取得独立报价，保留待确认。
A/H映射
A股开盘修复确认广谱风险偏好，个股反馈继续分化
09:45上证、深证和创业板分别涨0.73%、1.16%和1.64%，为隔夜科技修复与政策托底提供A股确认；核电、关键材料和传感器映射可继续观察，但不据此强行扩充候选。港交所获正反馈，华新并购遭负反馈，说明业务映射仍须逐股验证。

盘前结论

大盘：09:45上证、深证与创业板分别涨0.73%、1.16%和1.64%，政策托底与隔夜科技修复获得开盘确认。

确认：香港交易所涨0.83%至388.80港元，站上首轮388港元确认位，升级为看多候选。

否定：华新建材跌4.81%至26.14元，转为回避；汇聚科技虽反弹2.71%，仍未覆盖前日大跌且回购未执行，继续回避。

重点个股关注

香港交易所
00388.HK
看多候选

事实与状态：首三季收入与利润分别增12%和15%；11月9日09:45报388.80港元、涨0.83%，站上首轮388港元确认位。

继续确认：维持388港元上方，并由成交活跃度与IPO收入趋势继续验证。

风险与失效：成交回落、IPO周期转弱或重新跌破382.40港元，均会削弱或否定看多逻辑。

华新建材
600801.SH / 06655.HK
回避

事实与状态：拟约16.42亿美元收购巴西水泥资产，但11月9日09:45报26.14元、跌4.81%，显著跌破27.46元前收。

重新评估条件：完成审批与融资核验后，价格重新站回27.46元并恢复相对强势。

风险与失效：标的亏损、汇率、债务置换与中巴审批风险叠加；当前负面价格反馈优先，不包装为多头推荐。

汇聚科技
01729.HK
回避

事实与状态：11月9日09:45报10.23港元、涨2.71%，但未收复11月6日13.01%的跌幅，回购仍未见实际执行。

重新评估条件：披露实际回购、成交量恢复正常并重新站上10.66港元。

风险与失效：授权不等于完成买入，波动与流动性风险仍高；价格反转前不包装为多头机会。

板块轮动看板

A股风险修复三大指数09:45同步上涨，政策托底与科技映射由“待确认”转为开盘确认
交易与资本市场港交所业绩配合正向价格反馈，优于仅有公告而无价格确认的主题
并购分化华新跨境并购遭显著负反馈，审批、融资与整合风险压过标题催化
高波动回购汇聚科技小幅反弹仍未修复前日大跌，回购意向不等于完成买入

逻辑链

稳市机制 + 六张网 + 隔夜科技修复 → 三大A股指数开盘上涨 → 大盘风险偏好获得确认。
港交所双位数业绩增长 + 股价站上388港元 → 基本面与价格共振 → 升级看多候选。
华新跨境并购 + 4.81%下跌并跌破前收 → 负面价格反馈优先 → 转为回避。
汇聚科技回购意向 + 2.71%反弹但未修复前日13.01%跌幅 → 仍无反转确认 → 维持回避。

风险雷达

利率与估值美国就业强劲与高利率仍可能压制高估值科技，即使A股开盘修复。
并购执行华新价格负反馈凸显审批、融资、汇率与整合风险，公告金额不等于价值兑现。
回购兑现汇聚科技尚未验证实际买入，短线反弹不足以消除前日大跌风险。
数据时点09:45为东方财富公开延时报价；AKShare仍为11月6日14:48的旧基线，仅作背景。

数据来源与时间点

增量核验截止2026-11-09 09:50 CST。A/H指数与三只候选的09:45价格来自东方财富公开延时报价；AKShare v1.18.94为2026-11-06 14:48:40 CST旧基线，仅作背景并明确降级。美股排行来自GitHub Actions/Moomoo 2026-11-07 08:57 CST快照，对应11月6日现金时段。主要事实来源：Reuters、国务院、国家发展改革委、工业和信息化部、商务部、北京市政府、HKEX、巨潮资讯及公司公告。

Keyword Cloud

A-share open repair Strong payrolls HKEX confirmed Huaxin negative Policy floor Buyback pending
Major News
Global
Strong October US payrolls lift December hike odds
Payrolls rose by 165,000 versus a 65,000 Reuters consensus, while unemployment fell to 4.1%. The 10-year Treasury yield moved near 4.86% and December hike odds rose to about 78%, keeping pressure on expensive growth stocks. Source: Reuters.
Global
Oil eases at Monday's open on Iran de-escalation hopes
Trump said further attacks may not be necessary if negotiations deliver a strong agreement. Reuters' latest update put Brent down about 0.64% at $97.67, although shipping incidents keep geopolitical risk elevated. Source: Reuters.
Policy
State Council calls for a stronger market-stabilization mechanism
The Nov 6 meeting also called for faster Six Networks projects and support for equipment and intangible-asset investment. The direction helps sentiment but is not an automatic stock-level buy signal. Source: State Council meeting.
Policy
NDRC advances Six Networks projects and scenarios
The NDRC called for supporting policies, project pipelines, information sharing and factor guarantees. Computing, telecom, energy and logistics infrastructure are potential beneficiaries, but orders require company-level confirmation. Source: NDRC.
Tech
MIIT proposes a unified robot product identity code
The consultation draft would standardize manufacturing and support safety governance. It remains a draft and is not treated as corporate revenue. Source: MIIT.
Tech
Beijing E-Town expands support for open-source IT and frontier pilots
The policy covers AI, 6G, quantum information, supernode servers and AI terminals, with some pilot support up to RMB30 million. Beneficiaries still require company-level verification. Source: Beijing Government.
Materials
MOFCOM opens anti-dumping probe into EU para-aramid filament
The Nov 6 probe covers para-aramid 1414 filament. Domestic materials makers may draw attention, but an investigation is not a final tariff decision. Source: MOFCOM.
Filing
Jiesun Intelligence signs RMB4.915 billion computing-service contract
The tentative five-year contract is billed monthly with phased delivery. Customer execution, capex, delivery timing and margins remain key risks. Source: CLS weekend filing roundup.
Filing
CPIC Fiberglass plans RMB1.158 billion electronic-fabric project
The project targets 111 million metres of electronic-grade glass-fibre fabric annually over an roughly 11-month build. Ramp-up and end demand determine monetization. Source: CLS weekend filing roundup.
Hong Kong
HKEX posts double-digit nine-month revenue and profit growth
Revenue and other income rose 12% to HK$24.6 billion and shareholder profit rose 15% to HK$15.4 billion. At 09:45 on Nov 9, the shares were HK$388.80, up 0.83%, reclaiming the first-round HK$388 confirmation level. Trading and IPO cyclicality remain risks. Sources: HKEX, Eastmoney delayed quote.
Filing
Huaxin plans a roughly $1.642 billion Brazil cement acquisition
Huaxin plans to buy 99.99% of CSN Cimentos, subject to Chinese and Brazilian approvals. At 09:45 on Nov 9, the shares were RMB26.14, down 4.81% and well below the RMB27.46 prior close. The negative tape rejects the weekend catalyst, so the stock moves to Avoid. Sources: CNINFO, Eastmoney delayed quote.
Hong Kong
Time Interconnect plans up to HK$500 million of buybacks over 24 months
At 09:45 on Nov 9, the shares were HK$10.23, up 2.71%, but had not recovered the Nov 6 13.01% drop or the HK$10.66 reassessment level. The buyback remains an authorization rather than executed purchases, so the stock stays Avoid. Sources: company filing index, Eastmoney delayed quote.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Index tape
Tech rebound confirms, but the Dow and rates remain divergent
At the Nov 6 close, QQQ was $656.10 (+1.40%), SPY $735.29 (+0.35%) and DIA $512.22 (-0.39%); SOX rebounded 4.2%. Strong payrolls also lifted yields, so this is a tech repair rather than a broad risk-on reset.
Sector check
Advertising, power and lidar lead while gambling remains weakest
Moomoo showed Advertising Agencies +6.73% and Independent Power Producers +6.68%; Lidar +14.57% and Crypto Mining +12.67% led concepts. Gambling fell 6.43%. Runtime quotes aligned for EVC, OKLO, INDI and IREN; no independent UURAF quote was available.
A/H mapping
A-share open repair confirms broad risk appetite while stocks diverge
At 09:45, Shanghai, Shenzhen and ChiNext were up 0.73%, 1.16% and 1.64%, confirming the overnight tech repair and policy floor in A shares. Nuclear, critical-material and sensor mappings remain watchable without forcing extra candidates. HKEX received positive feedback while Huaxin's deal received negative feedback, so each mapping still requires stock-level validation.

Premarket View

Market: at 09:45, Shanghai, Shenzhen and ChiNext were up 0.73%, 1.16% and 1.64%, confirming the policy floor and overnight tech repair.

Confirmed: HKEX rose 0.83% to HK$388.80, clearing the first-round HK$388 level and upgrading to Bullish Candidate.

Invalidated: Huaxin fell 4.81% to RMB26.14 and moves to Avoid. Time Interconnect's 2.71% rebound still does not erase the prior plunge, so it remains Avoid.

Key Stock Watchlist

Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing
00388.HK
Bullish Candidate

Facts and status: Nine-month revenue and profit rose 12% and 15%. At 09:45 on Nov 9, the shares were HK$388.80, up 0.83%, clearing the first-round HK$388 confirmation level.

Further confirmation: Hold above HK$388 and sustain trading and IPO revenue momentum.

Risk / invalidation: Lower turnover, a weaker IPO cycle or another break below HK$382.40 would weaken or invalidate the bullish case.

Huaxin Building Materials
600801.SH / 06655.HK
Avoid

Facts and status: Huaxin plans a roughly $1.642 billion Brazil cement acquisition, but at 09:45 on Nov 9 the shares were RMB26.14, down 4.81% and well below the RMB27.46 prior close.

Reassessment: Verify approvals and funding, then recover RMB27.46 with relative strength.

Risk / invalidation: Target losses, FX, refinancing and regulatory risks combine with negative price feedback. It is not presented as bullish.

Time Interconnect Technology
01729.HK
Avoid

Facts and status: At 09:45 on Nov 9, the shares were HK$10.23, up 2.71%, but had not recovered the Nov 6 13.01% drop and no actual buyback execution was verified.

Reassessment: Actual buyback execution, normalized volume and a recovery above HK$10.66.

Risk / invalidation: Authorization is not completed buying, and volatility/liquidity risks remain high. It is not presented as bullish before a price reversal.

Sector Rotation Board

A-share risk repairAll three major indices rose at 09:45, turning policy and tech mappings from pending to opening confirmation
Trading and capital marketsHKEX earnings now have positive price feedback, stronger than themes supported only by headlines
M&A divergenceHuaxin's cross-border deal received sharp negative feedback as approval, funding and integration risks dominate
Volatile buybacksTime Interconnect's rebound does not repair the prior plunge; authorization is not completed buying

Logic Chain

Stabilization + Six Networks + overnight tech repair → all three major A-share indices rise at the open → broad risk appetite confirmed.
HKEX double-digit earnings growth + shares above HK$388 → fundamentals and tape align → upgrade to Bullish Candidate.
Huaxin cross-border deal + 4.81% drop below the prior close → negative price feedback dominates → Avoid.
Time Interconnect buyback intent + 2.71% rebound without repairing the prior 13.01% drop → no reversal confirmation → remain Avoid.

Risk Radar

Rates and valuationStrong US jobs and high rates can still pressure expensive technology despite the A-share open repair.
M&A executionHuaxin's negative tape highlights approval, funding, FX and integration risk; announced value is not realized value.
Buyback executionNo actual Time Interconnect purchases were verified, and a short rebound does not erase the prior plunge.
